title: 012你凭什么这么对他？！
slug: 年少情深被辜负他跪了我不要了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“萧萧，你...”

李铭烨后半句话卡在喉咙里，一个字也说不出来。

他刚才还笃定林萧会顺势放弃，下一秒就被拍在桌上的巴掌打了个措手不及。

几秒后，李铭烨才收回僵在嘴角的笑意。

他向来欣赏坚韧的性子，可眼前这般不肯认输的林萧，却让他心底生出几分忌惮。

倏然，李铭烨调整好表情，他紧紧握住林萧的手，半蹲至她身侧，神色坚定道：

“好，不管你想做什么我都支持。但

包厢里温度适宜，林萧心底却翻涌着怒火。

她在心里暗暗发誓，一定会让那些因为身份标签就看不起别人的人，付出代价！

农家院的午餐结束后，李铭烨没有直接带林萧回家。

车子拐进市中心最繁华的商业街，停在了她熟悉的那个高奢品牌门口。

“前几天看了看你衣柜，该添新衣服包包了。”李铭烨拉开副驾车门，朝林萧伸出手。

林萧看着那只手，犹豫了几秒，还是把手放了上去。

但在跟着李铭烨走进店里时，林萧心里突然飘过一个念头。

今天李铭烨太殷勤了，不像是他。

店里，导购殷勤地跟在身后。

李铭烨坐在沙发上，双腿交叠，林萧每试一件出来他都要点评几句。

“这件颜色太老气。”“这件腰收得不错。”“转一圈看看。”

林萧被他看得有些不自在，但试到一条烟灰色收腰连衣裙时，李铭烨沉默了两秒，然后站起来走到她身后，双手轻轻搭在她肩上，对着镜子里的她说：

“好看，包起来。”

李铭烨一共给林萧挑了七套衣服，七双鞋，七只包。

用他的话来说，什么样子的鞋子配什么包，什么样的包配什么鞋子。

乱了套，那就不好看了。

“今天为什么突然带我买东西？”林萧接过导购递来的购物袋，终于开口问了一句。

李铭烨很自然地单手接过林萧手里最重的那个袋子，另一只手牵着她朝电梯走，“晚上有个家宴，换了新衣服正好穿。”

“家宴？”

"Xiao Xiao, you..."

The second half of Li Mingye's words was stuck in his throat and he couldn't say a word.

Just now he was sure that Lin Xiao would give up, but the next second he was caught off guard by a slap on the table.

After a few seconds, Li Mingye retracted the smile that froze at the corner of his mouth.

He always admired his tenacity, but seeing Lin Xiao who was so unwilling to admit defeat made him feel a little wary in his heart.

Suddenly, Li Mingye adjusted his expression. He held Lin Xiao's hand tightly, squatted beside her, and said firmly:

"Okay, I support whatever you want to do. But

The temperature in the box was suitable, but Lin Xiao was filled with anger.

She secretly swore in her heart that she would make those who look down on others because of their identity labels pay the price!

After lunch at the farmyard, Li Mingye did not take Lin Xiao home directly.

The car turned into the busiest commercial street in the city center and stopped in front of the high-end luxury brand she was familiar with.

“I looked at your wardrobe a few days ago and it’s time to add new clothes and bags."Li Mingye opened the passenger door and stretched out his hand towards Lin Xiao.

Lin Xiao looked at the hand, hesitated for a few seconds, and then put his hand up.

But when following Li Mingye into the store, Lin Xiao suddenly had a thought in his mind.

Li Mingye was too attentive today, not like him.

In the store, the shopping guide followed diligently behind me.

Li Mingye sat on the sofa with his legs crossed. He would comment on every item Lin Xiao tried on.

“This color is too old-fashioned."This one cinches the waist nicely.""Take a look around.""

Lin Xiao felt a little uncomfortable when he saw him, but when he tried on a smoky gray waist dress, Li Mingye was silent for two seconds, then stood up and walked behind her, put his hands gently on her shoulders, and said to her in the mirror:

"It looks good, wrap it up."

Li Mingye picked a total of seven sets of clothes, seven pairs of shoes, and seven bags for Lin Xiao.

In his words, what kind of shoes goes with what kind of bag, and what kind of bag goes with what kind of shoes.

If it's messed up, it won't look good.

"Why did you suddenly take me shopping today?"Lin Xiao took the shopping bag from the shopping guide and finally asked.

Li Mingye naturally took the heaviest bag from Lin Xiao's hand with one hand, and led her towards the elevator with the other hand, "There is a family dinner tonight, and I have new clothes to wear."

“Family dinner?"
